title: Mighty Hits
overview:
Grab your gun and step into a toybox shooting gallery packed with quick-fire challenges. Each stage sets a different task - pop balloons, chase bees, hit targets, ring bells and more - set among toy soldiers, sunflowers, clocks, trains and other playful scenes.

Play alone, or hold a tournament for up to eight players taking turns to see who has the sharpest aim.

- A series of target-shooting stages
- For 1 to 8 players in Tournament Mode
- Compatible with the Virtua Gun and the Saturn mouse
